name: markdown
title: Markdown
description: Safe, token-styled Markdown with GFM, code copying and streaming fence repair. Raw HTML stays skipped by default and URL attributes always pass safeUrl, including plugin-created URLs and component overrides. components merges over kit renderers; codeRenderers matches languages case-insensitively and receives code, language, streaming and complete (false only for the repaired fence). customTags allowlists standalone block tags: children use the same Markdown pipeline, attributes exclude on* and style, and unclosed tags render only while streaming. Unknown or malformed tags stay in the normal skipped-HTML pipeline without consuming later prose. useMarkdownContext exposes streaming to every renderer. Keep component maps and plugin arrays stable to preserve memoisation. User remarkPlugins follow GFM; user rehypePlugins follow kit HTML processing. Overrides and plugins are trusted executable code receiving untrusted content: validate data, render React text/children, and never use dangerouslySetInnerHTML. allowHtml lazily imports rehype-raw and rehype-sanitize; until loaded, HTML stays skipped. Its fixed subset is b, strong, i, em, u, s, del, sub, sup, kbd, mark, abbr[title], br, details[open] and summary. Other raw elements unwrap to text; scripts, styles, frames, embeds, forms, media, SVG, MathML, template and textarea drop their contents. Event handlers and style attributes are removed. MarkdownCustom demonstrates overrides, chart fences, think tags, both plugin types, opt-in HTML and partial streaming. Copy actions show common.copyFailed when clipboard access fails; successful copies reset after 1600ms.
author: gntik-ai

import { focusRing } from '../utils/focus';

/**
 * Blinking caret drawn after the last block while text streams in. Pure CSS (an ::after on the
 * last child), so it follows paragraphs, list items and code without extra DOM.
 */
export const streamingCaretClass = [
  '[&>:last-child]:after:ms-0.5 [&>:last-child]:after:inline-block [&>:last-child]:after:h-[1.05em] [&>:last-child]:after:w-[2px]',
  "[&>:last-child]:after:translate-y-[2px] [&>:last-child]:after:bg-primary [&>:last-child]:after:content-['']",
  '[&>:last-child]:after:animate-pulse motion-reduce:[&>:last-child]:after:animate-none',
].join(' ');

/** Element classes for Markdown (token colours only). */
export const markdownStyles = {
  root: 'min-w-0 text-[14px] leading-[1.7] text-foreground [overflow-wrap:anywhere] [&>:first-child]:mt-0 [&>:last-child]:mb-0',
  h1: 'mt-5 mb-2 text-[18px] font-semibold tracking-tight',
  h2: 'mt-5 mb-2 text-[16px] font-semibold tracking-tight',
  h3: 'mt-4 mb-1.5 text-[14.5px] font-semibold',
  h4: 'mt-4 mb-1.5 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground',
  p: 'my-2.5',
  ul: 'my-2.5 list-disc space-y-1 ps-5 marker:text-muted-foreground',
  ol: 'my-2.5 list-decimal space-y-1 ps-5 marker:text-muted-foreground',
  li: 'ps-1 [&>ul]:my-1 [&>ol]:my-1 [&.task-list-item]:list-none [&.task-list-item]:-ms-5',
  blockquote: 'my-3 border-s-2 border-primary/50 ps-3.5 text-muted-foreground',
  hr: 'my-5 border-border',
  link: `rounded-sm font-medium text-primary-text underline decoration-primary/40 underline-offset-2 hover:decoration-primary ${focusRing}`,
  linkIcon: 'ms-0.5 inline-block align-[-1px]',
  inlineCode: 'rounded-md border border-border bg-secondary/60 px-1.5 py-px font-mono text-[12.5px]',
  tableWrap: 'my-3 overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-border',
  table: 'w-full border-collapse text-start text-[13px]',
  th: 'border-b border-border bg-secondary/50 px-3 py-2 font-semibold',
  td: 'border-b border-border px-3 py-2 align-top [tr:last-child_&]:border-b-0',
  checkbox: 'me-1.5 align-[-2px] accent-primary',
  image: 'text-muted-foreground italic',
  code: {
    root: 'my-3 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-border bg-secondary/40',
    header: 'flex h-9 items-center justify-between border-b border-border bg-secondary/50 ps-3 pe-1.5',
    lang: 'font-mono text-[11px] tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase',
    pre: 'overflow-x-auto p-3 font-mono text-[12.5px] leading-6',
  },
} as const;

/** Focus ring shared by every interactive element in the pack (brand rule). */
export const focusRing = 'focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus-ring';
